findings: (1) WHAT exec_row[1]! IS. ExecutionBusEntry = {multiplicity, pc, timestamp} (Interaction.lean:41). It is a FOREIGN openvm import; ZisK emits no execution bus. In bus_effect (BusEffect.lean), the 2-entry exec bus is split by multiplicity: exec_row[0] (mult=-1, the CONSUMER/read side, comment line 44 'we learn the current program counter') supplies the current PC as a learned read hypothesis; exec_row[1] (mult=+1, the PRODUCER/write side, comment line 120 'the second entry sets the next program counter') is the value written to Register.nextPC. So exec_row[1].pc semantically REPRESENTS the producer next-PC of this instruction. In RISC-V continuation semantics the producer next-PC at step i is exactly what the NEXT instruction consumes as its current PC = the real pc column at row i+1. This is the faithfulness anchor: exec_row[1].pc SHOULD equal the real pc(i+1).

(2a) EXACT h_nextPC_matches PROP. In the construction layer (ConstructionAdd.lean:156-159 / ConstructionSub.lean:217-220): `h_nextPC_matches : (register_type_pc_equiv |> (BitVec.ofNat 64 ((busSub trace binding i execRow).exec_row[1]!.pc).val)) = (PureSpec.execute_RTYPE_add_pure add_input).nextPC`. Because busSub.exec_row := execRow, this is literally `(coerced exec entry 1 pc of the caller-supplied execRow) = Sail pure next-PC`. The identical shape recurs in BusEmission.lean (12 shape lemmas), BusHypotheses.lean, AeneasBridgeTrust.lean (bus.exec_row[1]!.pc, lines 5410+), and as the RTypePromises.nextPC_matches structure field (RType.lean:55-56, with RHS pure_nextPC).

(2b) HOW bus_effect USES exec_row TO WRITE nextPC. BusEffect.lean lines 120-128: after the memory-bus foldl, `match post_memory.2 with | .ok _ state => EStateM.Result.map (...) (Sail.writeReg Register.nextPC (register_type_pc_equiv |> BitVec.ofNat 64 (execution_bus[1]!.pc).val) state)`. So the post-state's nextPC is DEFINITIONALLY exec_row[1].pc. The construction proof closes by feeding h_nextPC_matches into BusEmission lemmas (e.g. bus_effect_matches_sail_alu_rrw) which `simp only [h_nextPC_matches]` to rewrite that written value to the Sail pure next-PC, then commute the rd-write past the nextPC-write (write_reg_state_comm). So h_nextPC_matches is the SOLE link asserting the foreign exec_row[1].pc equals the Sail next-PC.

(3) NO existing fact links exec_row to the real Main pc column - GAP CONFIRMED. Exhaustive grep over origin/main AND xcap-x100-wiring: every occurrence of exec_row[*].pc lives inside bus_effect, the promise records, the BusEmission/BusHypotheses shape lemmas, or the construction binder. There is NO theorem, def, or constraint relating any ExecutionBusEntry.pc to MainRow.core.pc / mainOfTable(...).pc / the PcContChannel seam. The only constructor bridging op-bus->exec entry (execEntryOfOpBus, StateEffect.lean:64) takes pc as a free param and has ZERO callers. The PC seam (Constraints.lean pcLastMessageExpr/pcPrevMessageExpr) is built purely from row.core.* columns and never mentions ExecutionBusEntry. Hence the seam (pc(i+1)=nextpc(row i) on real columns) and h_nextPC_matches (exec_row[1].pc = Sail nextPC) live in DISJOINT vocabularies; the seam cannot discharge h_nextPC_matches.

(4) exec_row IS caller-chosen (Route C premise holds). busSub sets exec_row := execRow verbatim, and execRow is a genuine top-level forall-binder in every construction_<op>_sound. The constructions are currently standalone; the global theorem on origin/main reaches them via OpEnvelope where exec_row is likewise a forall-binder. PLAN_ENDGAME_P5.md §2/§4 confirms the intended trace-level assembly supplies each construction's residual binders (including h_nextpc, line 64) from per-step premises -- exactly the env-construction/caller layer Route C targets. Anti-vacuity note in ConstructionSub.lean:54-58 already insists execRow stay a real forall-binder (hard-coding execRow:=[] would make h_exec_len:0=2 contradictory => vacuous), so the binder is currently honest but UNDISCHARGED.
theRemainingGap: The seam proves a fact about REAL columns: pc(i+1) = nextpc_mux(row i). h_nextPC_matches is a fact about a FOREIGN artifact: exec_row[1].pc = Sail pure_nextPC. Closing Gap (c) requires a NEW theorem connecting exec_row[1].pc to the real pc(i+1) column (the exec-bus<->real-pc bridge). No such theorem exists; it must be built.

Two sub-equalities must compose to discharge h_nextPC_matches: (A) exec_row[1].pc = real pc(i+1)  [the MISSING bridge]; (B) real pc(i+1) = nextpc_mux(row i) = Sail pure_nextPC  [the seam, modulo a mux<->Sail-nextPC arithmetic lemma]. The seam delivers half of (B); (A) is entirely absent.

Even after (A), the seam's pushed value is the FULL next-PC mux (set_pc/jmp_offset branches), whereas the 30 sound constructions are the SEQUENTIAL pc+4 case (execute_RTYPE_add_pure.nextPC = PC+4). A specialization lemma (set_pc=0, store_pc=0 => mux = pc+4) is needed to equate nextpc_mux(row i) with the Sail sequential next-PC. SPINE-#2 / constraint_18 mux re-extraction (PR-X100.3) is required for the branch/jump TARGET cases.

keyDefinitions.name: BusRows (exec_row field)
keyDefinitions.role: A plain record `{ exec_row : List (Interaction.ExecutionBusEntry FGL); e0 e1 e2 : MemoryBusEntry FGL }`. `exec_row` is an ordinary mutable struct field, supplied by whoever builds a BusRows. Shared by ~52 OpEnvelope arms / wrappers / canonicals.

keyDefinitions.name: busSub
keyDefinitions.role: `@[reducible] def busSub trace binding i (execRow : List ...) : BusRows` sets `exec_row := execRow` VERBATIM (pure pass-through, no derivation) and builds e0/e1/e2 from the real Main memory emissions. The exec_row it carries is exactly the construction's ∀-binder.

keyDefinitions.name: construction_sub_sound
keyDefinitions.role: The honest sound construction. Takes `(execRow : List (Interaction.ExecutionBusEntry FGL))` as a genuine TOP-LEVEL ∀-binder, plus `h_nextPC_matches : (register_type_pc_equiv ▸ BitVec.ofNat 64 (busSub ... execRow).exec_row[1]!.pc.val) = (execute_RTYPE_sub_pure sub_input).nextPC`. So setting exec_row[1].pc := the real pc(i+1) from the trace Main table is the faithful population, NOT an arbitrary trivialization. exec_row[0] (the read entry, multiplicity -1, pc = current pc) is faithfully pc(i).
